match.src: comment: * If disk quotas is on, we make sure that the dquots do exist on disk, * before we start any other transactions. Trying to do this later * is messy. We don't care to take a readlock to look at the ids * in inode here, because we can't hold it across the trans_reserve. * If the IDs do change before we take the ilock, we're covered * because the i_*dquot fields will get updated anyway. */ [468,874]
